text:
tara: Quick sync — we need firmed-up rules for SI lead ownership exclusions + an escalation play we can hand to sales ops before Q2 planning. keeping it tight. :wave:
kevin: agree. main friction is sticky-account vs. new co-sell inbound. want a short checklist we can apply in intake. :eyes:
alex: propose 3 buckets: exclusive SI-owned, joint-touch, and redwood-owned. add explicit exclusion list (e.g., pipeline stage > demo+signed NDA owned by SI unless claimed).
sophie: can we codify as a triage matrix? sample snippet below I use for mapping:
```
if existing_si_relationship == true and ARR >= 250k -> exclusive SI-owned
elif opportunity_stage in [POC, Demo] and rep_requested_si == true -> joint-touch
else -> redwood-owned
```
kevin: love that. also add marketplace-sourced leads: they should default to redwood-owned unless SI had active engagement in last 90 days.
tara: what about demo routing rules? we get inconsistent behavior — some SIs want to own presales demos even when not in the contract.
alex: routing: if SI is exclusive -> SI runs demo. if joint-touch -> shared webinar + redwood presales + SI co-present. if redwood-owned -> redwood presales present, SI can be introduced at close stage only.
sophie: escalation: if SI claims ownership but intake shows redwood-owned, 24h SLA to resolve. if unresolved escalate to partnerships lead. draft policy: 24h -> partnerships -> 48h -> sales leader -> 72h -> CRO for arbitration.
kevin: add an exceptions queue for strategic accounts (>$1M ARR) where we ping GTM execs immediately. also require written handoff note in the intake ticket with 1-sentence rationale.
tara: workable. we should add a short discovery checklist that partners must complete at handoff, so redwood presales isn't surprised. sample:
- existing contracts with SI? (Y/N)
- last engagement date
- primary contact + role
- expected timeline and buying center
- any IP/custom HW constraints

alex: will the intake ticket live in salesops queue? triage-bot: yes — tickets created from marketplace or SDR form go into #si-intake queue and we append the triage matrix automatically.
triage-bot: automated note: "Intake received — applying SI triage matrix v1.2" (reaction :white_check_mark:)
sophie: assigned owners for next steps: kevin -> finalize triage matrix doc, tara -> write escalation play doc, alex -> update intake form + sample handoff template. can we get drafts by EOD Friday?
kevin: i can do matrix and sample cases. aiming for Friday 5pm PT. :thumbsup:
tara: i'll draft the escalation email chain and a short training slide for CS to spin up a 15m walkthrough.
alex: i'll update the intake form and add required fields. will add a quick validation check to block submissions missing the discovery checklist.
sophie: once ready we'll run a 30m sync with SI leads and SDRs next Monday. please add any edge cases to the doc — e.g., hardware co-sells where vendor has reseller rights.
kevin: note — add rule for partner-crediting: if SI runs POC and win -> credit to SI for first 12 months; renewals default back to customer owner unless otherwise agreed.
tara: thanks everyone — i'll create the confluence page and link the final docs in #partnerships when drafts are in. tagging @kevin @alex @sophie for visibility. :sparkles:
kevin: :+1:
triage-bot: reminder scheduled: "follow-up: SI triage doc review" on 2025-04-18 10:00 PT
